sample.english: In the name of God, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate.

sample.arabic: إِذا أردْت الِانْتِفَاع بِالْقُرْآنِ فاجمع قَلْبك عِنْد تِلَاوَته وسماعه
sample.english: If you want to benefit from the Quran, then gather your heart during its recitation and hearing [it],

sample.arabic: وأَلْقِ سَمعك واحضر حُضُور من يخاطبه بِهِ من تكلّم بِهِ سُبْحَانَهُ مِنْهُ إِلَيْهِ
sample.english: and direct your hearing, and be present [with] the presence of one whom the One who spoke it — glorified [is] He — addresses with it, from Him to him.

sample.arabic: فانه خَاطب مِنْهُ لَك على لِسَان رَسُوله
sample.english: For it [is] an address from Him to you upon the tongue of His messenger.

topics.english: Great Principle: If You Want to Benefit from the Quran, Then Gather Your Heart During Its Recitation and Hearing [It]
topics.arabic: قاعدة جليلة إذا أردت الانتفاع بالقرآن فاجمع قلبك عند تلاوته وسماعه

topics.english: Section: This surah has gathered from the foundations of faith what suffices, heals, and frees [one] from
topics.arabic: فصل وقد جمعت هذه السورة من أصول الإيمان ما يكفي ويشفي ويغني عن

topics.english: Great Benefit — [God] Most High's saying
topics.arabic: فائدة جليلة قوله تعالى

topics.english: A Benefit: The human has two powers — a power of knowledge and thought, and a power of action and will — and his happiness
topics.arabic: فائدة للإنسان قوتان قوة علمية نظرية وقوة عملية إرادية وسعادته

topics.english: Benefit: The Lord Most High calls His servants in the Quran to know Him through two paths
topics.arabic: فائدة الرب تعالى يدعو عباده في القرآن إلى معرفته من طريقين أحدهما

topics.english: Benefit — from the Musnad and Sahih of Abu Hatim, from the hadith of Abdullah ibn Mas'ud, [who] said
topics.arabic: فائدة في المسند وصحيح أبي الحاتم من حديث عبد الله بن مسعود قال

topics.english: Benefit: The Purest of Existing Things, the Most Manifest, Most Radiant, Most Noble, and Highest in Essence and Worth
topics.arabic: فائدة أنزه الموجودات وأظهرها وأنورها وأشرفها وأعلاها ذاتا وقدرا

topics.english: Benefit: The acceptance of [a] place for what [is] placed in it [is] conditioned on emptying it of its opposite
topics.arabic: فائدة قبول المحل لما يوضع فيه مشروط بتفريغه من ضده وهذا كما أنه

topics.english: Benefit: [God] Most High's saying 'Competing for more distracted you' to its end — this surah [is] devoted to the promise,
topics.arabic: فائدة قوله تعالى ألهاكم التكاثر إلى آخرها أخلصت هذه السورة للوعد

topics.english: Benefit: Protective jealousy [is of] two types — jealousy over [a] thing and jealousy from [a] thing. So jealousy over
topics.arabic: فائدة الغيرة غيرتان غيرة على الشيء وغيرة من الشيء فالغيرة على

topics.english: Chapter: Beware of sins, for they removed the honor of 'Prostrate!'
topics.arabic: فصل اياك والمعاصي فانها أزالت عز اسجدوا

topics.english: Benefit: Whoever lost his closeness with God among people and found it in solitude, he [is] truthful [but] weak
topics.arabic: فائدة من فقد أنسه بالله بين الناس ووجده في الوحدة فهو صادق ضعيف

topics.english: Chapter: This world [is] like an immoral woman [who] does not stay with [one] husband — she only courts husbands so they may admire her
topics.arabic: فصل الدنيا كامرأة بغي لا تثبت مع زوج إنما تخطب الأزواج ليستحسنوا

topics.english: Section: When the Awakened Ones Saw the Tyranny of This World over Its People and the Deception of Hope over Its Holders and the Mastery
topics.arabic: فصل لما رأى المتيقظون سطوة الدنيا بأهلها وخداع الأمل لأربابه وتملك

topics.english: A great benefit: The Prophet combined between God-consciousness and good character, because God-consciousness
topics.arabic: فائدة جليلة جمع النبى بين تقوى الله وحسن الخلق لأن تقوى الله

topics.english: A Principle: The testimony that there [is] no god but God at death has [a] great effect in erasing
topics.arabic: قاعدة لشهادة أن لا إله إلا الله عند الموت تأثير عظيم في تكفير

topics.english: Benefit: [God] Most High said, "And those who strive in Us, We will surely guide them [to] Our paths" — glorified [is] He — He linked guidance
topics.arabic: فائدة قال تعالى والذين جاهدوا فينا لنهدينهم سبلنا علق سبحانه الهداية

topics.english: Chapter: God, glorified [is] He, cast enmity between the devil and the angel, and enmity between
topics.arabic: فصل ألقى الله سبحانه العداوة بين الشيطان وبين الملك والعداوة بين

topics.english: Chapter: When the Messenger of God came out of the siege of the enemy, he entered the siege of victory
topics.arabic: فصل لما خرج رسول الله من حصر العدو دخل في حصر النصر

topics.english: Chapter: O you [who are] deceived by wishful thinking — Iblis was cursed and cast down from the station of honor for leaving a single prostration
topics.arabic: فصل يا مغرورا بالأماني لعن إبليس وأهبط من منزل العز بترك سجدة واحدة

topics.english: Chapter: The first of created things was the Pen to write the decrees before their existence, and He made Adam the last
topics.arabic: فصل كان أول المخلوقات القلم ليكتب المقادير قبل كونها وجعل آدم وآخر

topics.english: Section: When the Foundation of Servitude Was Sound for Adam, the Sin Did Not Damage It
topics.arabic: فصل لما سلم لآدم أصل العبودية لم يقدح فيه الذنب ابن آدم لو

topics.english: Chapter: When the Messenger pledged with the people of al-Aqaba, he commanded his companions to migrate to Medina
topics.arabic: فصل لما بايع الرسول أهل العقبة أمر أصحابه بالهجرة إلى المدينة

topics.english: Section: You trained your dog, and it leaves its desire to eat what it caught, out of respect for your blessing and fear
topics.arabic: فصل علمت كلبك فهو يترك شهوته في تناول ما صاده احتراما لنعمتك وخوفا

topics.english: Benefit: Abandoning the Quran [is of several] types — the first being abandoning listening to it, having faith in it, and paying attention to it
topics.arabic: فائدة هجر القرآن أنواع أحدها هجر سماعه والإيمان به والإصغاء إليه

topics.english: A benefit: The perfection of the self [that is] sought [is] what includes two matters, one of them [is] that it becomes a firm disposition and quality
topics.arabic: فائدة كمال النفس المطلوب ما تضمن أمرين أحدهما أن يصير هيئة راسخة وصفة

topics.english: Benefit: Knowledge [Is] Transferring the Image of the Known from the Outside and Establishing It in the Self, and Action [Is] Transferring
topics.arabic: فائدة العلم نقل صورة المعلوم من الخارج وإثباتها في النفس والعمل نقل

topics.english: Principle: Faith has an outward and an inward [aspect]; its outward [is] the speech of the tongue and the action of the limbs, and its inward [is]
topics.arabic: قاعدة الإيمان له ظاهر وباطن وظاهره قول اللسان وعمل الجوارح وباطنه

topics.english: A Principle: Reliance [on God] [is] Two Types, One of Them [is] Reliance on Him in Bringing the Needs of the Servant
topics.arabic: قاعدة التوكل على الله نوعان أحدهما توكل عليه في جلب حوائج العبد

topics.english: A Grand Principle — [God] Most High Said
topics.arabic: قاعدة جليلة قال الله تعالى

topics.english: A Great Benefit — [God] Most High said:
topics.arabic: فائدة جليلة قوله تعالى

topics.english: Benefit: Desire for the Hereafter [is] not complete except through detachment from this world, and detachment [is] not sound
topics.arabic: فائدة لا تتم الرغبة في الآخرة إلا بالزهد في الدنيا ولا يستقيم الزهد

topics.english: A Principle: The Foundation of Every Good [Is] That You Know That Whatever God Willed [Will] Happen and Whatever He Did Not
topics.arabic: قاعدة أساس كل خير أن تعلم أن ما شاء الله كان وما لم

topics.english: A Great Benefit: Whoever from the people of knowledge prefers this world and loves it, then inevitably...
topics.arabic: فائدة جليلة كل من آثر الدنيا من أهل العلم واستحبها فلا بد أن

topics.english: Section: This [is] the state of the scholar who prefers this world over the Hereafter, and as for the ignorant worshipper
topics.arabic: فصل فهذا حال العالم المؤثر الدنيا على الآخرة وأما العابد الجاهل

topics.english: A Great Benefit: The Best [Thing] That Souls Have Gained and Hearts Have Obtained, and by Which the Servant Attained
topics.arabic: فائدة عظيمة أفضل ما اكتسبته النفوس وحصلته القلوب ونال به العبد

topics.english: A Great Benefit: Only the one who leaves habits and customs for other than God finds difficulty in leaving them
topics.arabic: فَائِدَة جليلة إِنَّمَا يجد الْمَشَقَّة فِي ترك المألوفات والعوائد من تَركهَا لغير الله

topics.english: A Great Principle — [God] Most High Said
topics.arabic: قاعدة جليلة قال الله تعالى

topics.english: Chapter: Ten Wasted Things That Bring No Benefit — Knowledge That [Is] Not Acted Upon, and Deeds That [Have] No...
topics.arabic: فصل عشرة أشياء ضائعة لا ينتفع بها علم لا يعمل به وعمل لا

topics.english: Chapter: On whoever leaves choice and planning in hope of increase or fear of decrease or seeking
topics.arabic: فصل من ترك الاختيار والتدبير في رجاء زيادة أو خوف نقصان أو طلب

topics.english: Chapter: The sign of [a] sound will [is] that the seeker's concern [is] his Lord's pleasure and his readiness to meet Him
topics.arabic: فصل علامة صحة الإرادة أن يكون هم المريد رضا ربه واستعداده للقائه

topics.english: Great Benefit — Sahl ibn Abdullah said: abandoning the command [is], with God, greater than
topics.arabic: فائدة جليلة قال سهل بن عبد الله ترك الأمر عند الله أعظم من

topics.english: The Eighteenth Point
topics.arabic: الْوَجْه الثَّامِن عشر

topics.english: The Nineteenth Point
topics.arabic: الْوَجْه التَّاسِع عشر

topics.english: Chapter: The foundation of the religion [is] upon two principles — remembrance and gratitude. [God] Most High said:
topics.arabic: فصل مبنى الدين على قاعدتين الذكر والشكر قال تعالى

topics.english: Section: [It is] repeated in the Quran [that] the deeds established in the heart and the limbs [are a] cause of guidance
topics.arabic: فصل تكرر في القرآن جعل الأعمال القائمة بالقلب والجوارح سبب الهداية

topics.english: Section: As for the second principle — which [is] that wickedness, arrogance, and lying lead to misguidance — [it is] plentiful
topics.arabic: فصل وأما الأصل الثاني وهو اقتضاء الفجور والكبر والكذب للضلال فكثير

topics.english: Chapter: As He, glorified [is] He, pairs guidance with God-consciousness and misguidance with deviance, so too He pairs between
topics.arabic: فصل وكما يقرن سبحانه بين الهدى والتقى والضلال والغي فكذلك يقرن بين
